notes.title: Action-Adventure game Angeline Era's releasing this year!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone! Melos from the dev team here. I forgot to announce this on steam, but we are planned for a Q4 2025 release!! Well, we can't announce the exact date yet... but barring any unexpected delays the game should be out this year! Hooray! Recently we've been finishing up the various cutscenes. Then we'll do a final art and testing pass to release the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Uh... right well that's all I have to say... you can wishlist it here...[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393920/Angeline_Era/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you haven't yet, enjoy a photo of the overworld![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231730/80512b21cea0099d0d55a25d88f4ca01fff99f0b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 39,000 Wishlists... and a Development Update 2025/08!!
notes.content: [p]Hey all! Melos from the team here. We made a recent devlog post- if you're interested, just search "Melos Han-Tani Substack" on google and read the latest post![/p][p]But I'll summarize a bit here.[/p][p]So, we are on good progress for releasing this year - likely still November or December![/p][p]We may only be releasing in English first with a localized version coming in following months, although at a minimum we are trying to have Simplified Chinese and Brazilian Portuguese available at launch. Our remaining target languages (Russian, Japanese, Korean, Spanish) will be done if we make enough money.[/p][p]One big milestone for us is finishing the overworlds. Angeline Era has a lot of levels - between 8-20 hours for a single playthrough depending how thorough you are. Here's a preview of one of the first overworld areas:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231730/37a2d1d1c932a301f54ba481bf9ddda6ca3c5d2f.png"][/img][/p][p]Outside of that, I finished the music, a bunch of SFX, and some test playthroughs of the game for design/bugtesting/narrative reasons. Marina on the art side has finished a bunch of new area, NPC, and enemy art, as well as some final writing for the game. We're hoping the game has a unique approach to story and lore! You can enjoy the main storyline, or explore all the areas and imagine for yourself what the backstories to the world are.[/p][p]Other than that, we hit 39,000 total wishlists! Honestly I couldn't ask for much more. I'm just hoping we can have a smooth rest of development for now as I go into some closed Beta testing.[/p][p]Please look forward to Angeline Era later this year! We'll also be keeping the demo up through release - which will retain its multiple translations.[/p][p]Anyways, if you'd like to support us till release, consider sharing a trailer with your friend groups.[/p][list][*][p]Melos[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Danchi Days Demo - check out our new summer adventure!
notes.content:
Hello, Analgesic fans! Melos Han-Tani here. Did you know I've been working on a 2nd game in addition to Angeline Era?
It's called Danchi Days! And we have a demo out now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3312850/Danchi_Days_Demo/

It's a slice-of-life adventure set in a 2000's Japanese setting, where you control a girl named Hoshino! You'll explore her neighborhood, while hoping to revive the local summer festival for her beloved grandmother. It's a moving story with a lot of memorable characters. I hope you'll like it!

I'm working on it with a separate team of 3 (gingham games), but publishing it under Analgesic. We'd love for you to try the demo out and leave a review!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33021367/83cdc9810f1a7d1017e141f060f3f8618010bbf5.png[/img]

notes.title: Coming to Steam Next Fest! New Languages, 30,000 Wishlists
notes.content:
Hi everyone! First, we'd like to celebrate 30,000 wishlists by announcing we'll be in the Steam Next Fest in a few weeks!! In other words... we plan to release sometime later in 2025.

In the meantime, with the help of Dragonbaby Localization, we localized the demo into 6 new languages. Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish (LA), Brazilian Portuguese, and Russian! It's now out in Version 9, so please play and enjoy. The demo is the same as last year, but there may be new bugs so just let me know : )

If these are your languages we hope you enjoy and please do share with your communities, as interest in the demo will decide which of these languages we localize into first for the final game (as we don't have the budget to do all of them yet.)

notes.title: Incredible... 22k wishlists!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thanks to LudoNarraCon, the Summer Games Fest, and various coverage, including a video by IronPineapple - I'm happy to announce we've reached 22,000 wishlists! Our number almost doubled over the past month.

This is great news for us as we can relax a bit and have some confidence that the game will sell pretty well when it launches in 2025! Thank you for your support and keep on Bumpslashing!

In the meantime... what's new? Why not read about some of the philosophy behind [url=https://melodicambient.substack.com/p/action-adventure-storytelling-and]Angeline Era's level design?[/url]

notes.title: 15,000 Wishlists Hit! Try the new Arcade Mode!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231730/5fb8c845669e2d1374725ad6f52898de647224e6.png[/img]

Hey everyone - since the LudoNarraCon and Summer Game Fests, we've hit a new goal - 15,000 wishlists! We're well on our way for more people to try "Bumping the World" in this Revolutionary Bumpslash Adventure.

If you haven't yet, go try the demo today and wishlist the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393920/Angeline_Era/

I'd like to highlight something you may have missed if you played the demo right away - we've updated the Arcade Mode with a new "Point Gate" feature. Instead of the regular game's gameplay where you kill certain enemies to open doors, in the new Arcade Mode, you instead only have to defeat enough enemies to reach a certain # of points as indicated by each door. You can kill more weaker enemies, or fewer strong ones to progress! Or, keep them all alive - and build your combo meter sky-high to reach a high score! The choice is yours...

Also, have you heard the soundtrack yet? Search Angeline Era on Bandcamp, Spotify, or any Streaming platform to listen!

notes.title: New Trailer for Angeline Era!
notes.content:
Hello, co-developer Melos here! Today, we've released a 2nd trailer, in conjunction with the Game Devs of Color Expo that starts today! Do [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/gdocexpo]check it out[/url] if you're curious to see some great games made by primarily POC-led teams!

Here's the trailer:

[previewyoutube=_15akBJq6rU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Other than that, we've broken 6,000 wishlists! So far this is our strongest pre-launch wishlisting campaign yet, so hopefully we can sell enough to remain afloat... ha ha ha! We were also featured in the EEK3 2023 Showcase - a spooky and horror-themed indie game showcase, featuring some of our friends' games as well.

So, what's new in Angeline Era? This summer has been full of level design for me, personally. I've written a song here or there, but primarily I've been getting into a groove and really nailing down the levels - and I'm really excited about the result. Levels range from 3 to 10 minute experiences, and you can enter them from wherever on the overworld. Some levels are linear and challenging - others are sprawling and goal-less - and some are dungeon-y with tricky navigation. There's all kinds of levels in this game, and I'm excited to share all the humorous and creative ideas we've come up with.

On Marina's end, she made significant progress on the script of the game, as well as progress on finalizing the art style (what we show in the trailer/this store page is a little out of date.) That'll be coming together very quickly soon, so I'm excited to show what's next!

NOW, if you've read this far...

We're still selling t-shirts and other game related merch at our store! Check it out here: https://analgesicproductions.bigcartel.com/

Other game updates include:

- A 60 FPS / QOL-update remaster is planned for Anodyne 1 - likely dropping on PC next month, and consoles next year
- Our 2016 platformer Even the Ocean was open sourced!
- The Anodyne 2 physicals will be shipping out soon - with extras available to buy on Amazon later this year!
- ... more planned!

If you'd like to stay up to date on news, follow me on Twitter
https://twitter.com/han_tani

or subscribe to my newsletter! https://melodicambient.substack.com/

notes.title: Introducing the Overworld
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Melos, co-developer of Angeline Era here. Did you know the game has an overworld? It's where you'll enter a variety of levels - dungeons, forests, caves, towns - or perhaps strange, small clearings, campgrounds, and even farms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231730/e326f9b1002e0746396a5e1970cfe4e3c65b7815.png[/img]

Last week on Twitter, I posted a video showing how some of the overworld exploration works. You can watch it here:

[url=https://twitter.com/han_tani/status/1690351254546120704]https://twitter.com/han_tani/status/1690351254546120704[/url]

In particular, by reaching the end of levels, sometimes the overworld will be updated - maybe trees will vanish, a bridge will be built, etc.

You'll need to keep an eye out for level entrances. However, not all level entrances will be easily visible! You may have to search to find some of them. A level could be laying just out of sight...

Well, it's back to working on the game. Development is going smoothly - please wishlist the game if intersted!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393920
